checks.name: Demo data renders; Google Maps uses the exact stop and current-position origin
Arrival navigation mode is visible and can be chosen independently of the outgoing leg
Service worker controls /travel/ and install manifest uses a relative scope
320–1440px layouts do not overflow; full-map browser Back preserves the date
Simulated GPS displays the provided accuracy, clearly as a single reading
Synthetic private fragment is removed; home address persists after reload
Malformed nested fields never become an update candidate or overwrite offline data
New data waits for a click and preserves the saved private home
Invalid new JSON keeps the last validated trip
Offline reload restores app shell, accepted text, airport empty state and home
GPS denial leaves the plan usable; a second browser has no first-browser home
Cache contains only the local app shell; no tile/photo caching and no JS page errors
